items.title: Civil aviation minister announces technical trilateral committee involving India, Oman, UAE
items.summary: Union Civil Aviation Minister K Rammohan Naidu announced a trilateral committee involving India, Oman, and the UAE. This committee aims to tackle operational challenges related to regional airspace. A recent meeting included discussions on these topics amid evolving geopolitical circumstances. Upcoming technical discussions are scheduled with the International Civil Aviation Organisation’s regions this month. These collaborations seek to foster coordinated solutions for airspace operations in the region.

items.title: India needs to create high-quality jobs, increase productivity growth: IMF
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund has upgraded India's potential growth to 6.8 percent, citing favorable demographics and a growing economy. Higher productivity growth and stronger private investment are essential to realize this potential. Faster creation of high-quality jobs is also crucial for sustainable economic development. The IMF continues to view India as a key growth engine for the global economy.

items.title: Retail inflation may remain above 6 pc for next few months; economists see possibility of rate hikes
items.summary: Mumbai's consumer price index-based retail inflation is projected to remain above 6 percent in upcoming months. This rise is attributed to increasing food prices, an adverse base effect, and commodity price impacts. Economists predict that retail inflation will average 6.2 percent in the October-December quarter of FY27. Heightened food prices and weather-related risks pose ongoing challenges for crop production.

items.title: SBI economists halve December RBI rate hike forecast to 25 bps on easing rupee pressure, foreign inflows
items.summary: State Bank of India has revised its estimate for the upcoming Reserve Bank of India rate hike. The new projection suggests a 0.25 percent increase instead of a previously expected 0.50 percent. This adjustment follows improvements in external conditions and a revival in foreign fund inflows. Analysts note that inflation is projected to remain above 6 percent in November before easing.

Goyal emphasized that the outcomes of the negotiations will be beneficial for India.

items.title: Shree Cement to invest Rs 7,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh; plans plants in 3 districts
items.summary: Shree Cement Ltd plans to invest Rs 7,000 crore to establish cement plants in Andhra Pradesh. The company will set up facilities in Kadapa, Anakapalli, and Guntur districts. This decision comes after incentives from the coalition government led by Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu. Shree Cement aims to increase its production capacity beyond 80 million tonnes in the near future.

items.title: NCLT approves merger of Jana Holdings with Jana Capital
items.summary: NCLT approved the amalgamation of Jana Holdings Ltd with Jana Capital Ltd effective November 3, 2026. Both companies belong to the promoter group of Jana Small Finance Bank Limited. The amalgamation aims to eliminate the Non-Operative Financial Holding Company layer while ensuring a seamless transition of assets and liabilities. Jana Holdings was established in January 2017 for regulatory compliance and will be dissolved post-merger.

Governments are encouraged to engage in benchmarking to identify competitive strategies for their respective aviation markets. Sustainable Aviation Fuel production remains constrained, impacting airlines' decarbonization efforts.

items.title: Oyster Renewable to complete Rs 350-crore wind-solar project in Andhra Pradesh by December
items.summary: Oyster Renewable Energy is nearing completion of a 60.9 MW wind-solar hybrid project in Kadapa district. The project will be operational by next month and includes solar and wind energy capacity. The solar capacity has already been commissioned and operational, generating significant electricity annually. Once complete, the project aims to reduce CO₂ emissions considerably each year. Laurus Labs will benefit from reliable renewable power through this hybrid energy initiative.

items.title: Fairfax's Rs 52,878-crore IDBI Bank deal sets stage for a financial services powerhouse
items.summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings has successfully acquired a controlling stake in IDBI Bank for Rs 52,878 crore. The investment aims to redefine IDBI Bank as a comprehensive financial services provider in India and abroad. Fairfax plans to integrate its existing insurance and capital market businesses into IDBI Bank to enhance its offerings. The acquisition reflects Fairfax's strategy of leveraging IDBI Bank's infrastructure for greater market competitiveness.

items.title: India's 'achievable' FY27 direct tax target faces a make-or-break second half
items.summary: India's budgeted direct tax collection target for this fiscal year is Rs 26.97 lakh crore. Current collections are at approximately 53 percent of this target as of November 10. Experts flag the need for a rise in corporate tax and advance tax collections in upcoming months. Non-corporate tax collections have shown slower growth compared to corporate tax collections during the same period.

items.title: KL Rahul invests in PlayBlue, joins as brand ambassador ahead of flagship store launch
items.summary: KL Rahul will invest in PlayBlue, a multi-brand sports retail venture launching its flagship store on November 14. The flagship store in Bengaluru will feature over 75 brands, including apparel and sporting equipment. PlayBlue aims to create an integrated platform that offers expert guidance and experiential retail for consumers. It plans to expand its presence to more than 100 stores across India over the next five years.

items.title: RBI plans curbs on private equity firms controlling stakes in multiple non-bank lenders: Report
items.summary: India's central bank is working on new rules to prevent private equity firms from holding controlling stakes in multiple non-bank lenders. The proposal aims to mitigate potential financial risks stemming from global private equity firms' investments. While larger stakes will attract greater scrutiny, smaller investments are encouraged to support growth in the financial sector. Recent data shows significant foreign investment in non-bank lenders, highlighting strong demand for credit.

items.title: GAIL, KRIBHCO explore $1.6 billion urea plant in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: GAIL (India) and KRIBHCO have signed an agreement to explore constructing a urea plant in Andhra Pradesh. The plant is expected to generate direct and indirect job opportunities for local residents. Officials aim to set up a facility producing 1.27 million tons of urea per year in Srikakulam. The state government will support the initiative by providing land and infrastructure.

The broadened scope of India's FTAs promises to enrich economic interactions and spur advancements in emerging technologies such as AI and biotechnology.
